description: AI search and discovery API for websites and apps, with a no-card free tier and usage-based Grow and Grow Plus plans.

pricing.details: Free, no credit card — 10,000 search requests/month, 50,000 records, 5,000 recommendation requests/month, 5,000 crawls/month. Grow (keyword search) and Grow Plus (keyword search with AI capabilities, including AI Synonyms, AI Ranking and advanced personalization) are officially starting at 0 €/month. The official FAQ includes 10,000 search requests, 10,000 Recommend requests, 100,000 records, 10,000 crawls per month and 1 free Guide on Grow and Grow Plus, with billing only for usage above each included allowance. Recommendation and crawler overage rates, in the original currency, remain in the official notes (they would be misleading once rounded to whole euros). The overage rate for search requests beyond the included 10,000 was not isolated as a public list price and is not listed. Elevate is starting at custom / request pricing and requires an annual contract.
